disqualified_basins_archive.note: All 6 excluded regional basins are archived directly from profiling/p1.json. Specifically, Lost_Cove_TN (48.7% 30m NLCD-41, 38.4% pasture) and Sinking_Cove_TN (57.1% 30m NLCD-41) fell below the 60% deciduous-floor criterion and therefore sit outside the 11 P1 phenology pairs; both join 5 P1 basins in the 7-cove ECOSTRESS tile 16SED thermal replication. Karst_AL_15 collapsed to 0 m fill depth at 30 m.

dose_response_aic.closure_gap_note: All 11 open gorges have FillDepth = 0 m and all 11 closed karst basins have 30 m FillDepth in [22.2, 79.4] m (zero observations in 0 < FillDepth < 22.2 m). Because min(FillDepth, 25 m) equals 25 * is_closed on 21/22 sites, M5_fill_hinge25m and binary M3_fill_step20m are statistically indistinguishable (dAICc = 0.03 on dGSL) and both restate binary topographic closure rather than resolving a continuous 0-22 m dose-response ramp. Within the 11 closed basins above 22 m, deeper 30 m sills do not add further compression (r(dEOS, FillDepth_30m) = +0.25, p = 0.45; r(dGSL, FillDepth_30m) = +0.44, p = 0.18).
